latest.title: Weekend Agent Challenge: Leitner Loop
latest.description: Leitner Loop - AWS Certification Always On Agent Studying for an AWS certification usually means remembering to sit down, open a study app, and grind through flashcards and that habit dies the moment life gets busy. Leitner Loop removes the "open the app" step entirely. It's an always-on study partner that runs on its own schedule, decides what you need to review next, writes brand-new practice questions for it, and emails them to you no button click required.

latest.title: Alarmas que despiertan por causa real, no por un número random
latest.description:
El escenario es un trabajo en segundo plano en una plataforma de
comunidad: un matcher nocturno que empareja items nuevos contra un pool de usuarios elegibles y escribe filas a una tabla matches. Pero la lección es general: cualquier alarma sobre un conteo de salida (items emparejados, correos enviados, registros procesados, recomendaciones generadas) tiene el mismo fallo.

trending.title: AWS Strands Agents vs LangChain: A Practical Guide to Choosing the Right Framework
trending.description:
I learned LangChain at work, then saw AWS Strands Agents' tool-calling loop and wondered: is this the same thing with a different name? 
This article is the real answer, not a spec-sheet comparison, covering who owns the control logic (you vs. the model), boilerplate and debugging, deployment via Bedrock AgentCore vs. self-managed stacks, and a decision checklist for each. Includes a companion repo with both frameworks built side by side, tested live against Bedrock, so you can run them yourself.
